lanes.name: Marketing, growth & e-commerce
lanes.why: Uses her TikTok Shop, creator and brand work directly; adds analysis on top.
lanes.day: A merchant campaign underperformed. Work out why and recommend the next change.
lanes.skills: SQL joins, funnel metrics, Excel pivots; evaluate the reason for a result.

lanes.name: Consumer insights & research
lanes.why: Connect behavior, research and business decisions.
lanes.day: Combine interviews, a survey and sales data into a customer recommendation.
lanes.skills: Survey design, descriptive statistics, Excel; quantitative research may demand more.

lanes.name: Product management & operations
lanes.why: Use real founder examples to show customer understanding and prioritization.
lanes.day: Choose the most important customer problem and define a measurable feature.
lanes.skills: Product case writing, usage metrics, stakeholder communication; technical depth varies.

lanes.name: Strategy, consulting & business operations
lanes.why: Structured problem-solving for leadership; founder experience is a real asset here.
lanes.day: A unit missed its plan. Size the gap, find the two causes that matter, and recommend a fix.
lanes.skills: Excel models, crisp slides, structured reasoning, basic SQL.

lanes.name: Business analysis, sales & revenue ops
lanes.why: Turn process knowledge and analysis into better business execution.
lanes.day: Find why a sales or service process is slow, then test a fix.
lanes.skills: Excel, basic SQL, process mapping and structured business reasoning.

lanes.name: Merchandising, pricing & category
lanes.why: Connect inventory and merchandising experience with analytical planning.
lanes.day: Explain a stockout or promotion result and build a better forecast.
lanes.skills: Excel forecasting, SQL, uncertainty; avoid advanced optimization roles initially.

lanes.name: Operations, supply chain & industrial engineering
lanes.why: Her ISE program trains exactly this: optimization, forecasting, process and supply-chain decisions.
lanes.day: Orders are shipping late from one warehouse. Find the bottleneck and test a better plan.
lanes.skills: Excel, SQL, forecasting and optimization basics (ISE 530), process mapping.

lanes.name: Finance & FP&A
lanes.why: Test whether business performance and financial planning are interesting.
lanes.day: Explain a budget variance and forecast the next quarter.
lanes.skills: Financial statements, accounting basics, Excel modeling; a real domain-learning cost.

lanes.name: Data, BI & data science
lanes.tier: Build toward; data science is a stretch
lanes.why: Develop SQL and data-quality skills on real business questions.
lanes.day: Clean data, define a metric, produce a chart and explain a decision.
lanes.skills: SQL joins and windows, one BI tool, Python fundamentals, basic inference.

lanes.name: Other directions to explore
lanes.why: Roles that fit none of the named directions. Kept so new fields can surface.
lanes.day: Varies — read the posting and react.
